subject.title: fix(signal): detect native bot mentions in group gating

question: Should OpenClaw accept stricter Signal native-only `requireMention` behavior for existing groups with configured bot identity but no text mention patterns?
rationale: The code path is localized and well proven, but it intentionally changes existing upgrade behavior for some Signal group configurations, so automation should not decide the compatibility tradeoff.

options.title: Accept stricter native gating
options.body: Merge with the documented behavior that native-only Signal `requireMention` groups now drop unmentioned messages into bounded pending context.

options.title: Require a transition path
options.body: Ask for a migration, release-note policy, or opt-in strict mode if preserving old pass-through behavior matters for existing deployments.

options.title: Pause the stack
options.body: Pause or close this PR if native metadata should not make Signal mention detection enforceable yet.

recommendation.title: Accept stricter native gating
recommendation.body: Merge with the documented behavior that native-only Signal `requireMention` groups now drop unmentioned messages into bounded pending context.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent shared mention-policy and Signal mention-gating history makes this the best available routing owner for the compatibility decision.
